description: This file contains implementation of the CordRepBtreeNavigator class, including functions for navigating and reading from a tree-based string representation structure used internally in the Abseil library.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeNavigator
classes.description: Navigator class for traversing CordRepBtree structures.

classes.name: CordRepBtree
classes.description: Represents a B-tree structure used for string storage.

classes.name: CordRep
classes.description: Base class for string node representations.

classes.name: CordRepSubstring
classes.description: Represents a substring view of a CordRep node.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips n bytes in the tree structure, returning the position after skipping.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a segment of data from the tree structure starting at a given offset.
